strict_score_basis.determination: The locked targeted rubric expressly assigns 0.5 when three or four of five expected items are present. The blinded scoring protocol requires both primary and strict score fields but defines no separate strict threshold or override. Therefore strict has no registered basis to lower an otherwise correct three-of-five targeted response from 0.5 to 0.0.
